paragraphs.text:
Located on the western side of the pyramid, the tomb’s opening 
has been made into a tourist entrance. You see the vast expanse of 
the pyramid and the small dusty entrance to the tomb through 
which tourists pass. You can go in, at 376; or look around the 
pyramid at 360; or you can return to the village at 324.
(360)
